technicalOversold.method: Unweighted mean of three lower-tail ranks vs prior 252 sessions

source: Yahoo Finance cash ^NDX daily closes; Wilder RSI(14) calculated
methodology: Cash NDX daily Wilder RSI(14): below 20 extremely oversold, 20–30 oversold. This indicates past selling pressure, not a reversal guarantee, forecast or instruction to trade. technicalOversold.score (0–100) is the average lower-tail percentile for RSI14, MA20 gap, and 5d return over 252 earlier sessions; not a percentage of decline completed.
